description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {3}.
Ovika triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens that gain haste until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Phyrexian Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Razor Boomerang's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to a Phyrexian Goblin.
Activate the Phyrexian Goblin by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Goblins, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
